expectations.text: Advises against the fully open CFP for this edition
expectations.evidence: 'Not recommended: a "fully open CFP" for the whole event.'

expectations.text: Names both promotion conditions for open submissions: a compounding annual property and the political capital to tell an executive their slot did not make the program
expectations.evidence: 'Q7 says the event compounds as an annual property, and Q8 says you have political capital to refuse an executive.'

expectations.text: States the collapse failure: without that political capital the open posture becomes a company-supplied program with extra administration, the worst outcome on the menu
expectations.evidence: 'collapse into a company-supplied program with extra administration, the worst cell on the menu.'

expectations.text: Recommends the mixed practitioner program with labelled company slots as the default posture
expectations.evidence: 'Program posture: mixed practitioner program with labelled company slots.'

expectations.text: Requires the company slots to be labelled as company content rather than dressed as neutral sessions
expectations.evidence: 'Label them as such on the program. Don't present them as neutral content.'

expectations.text: States the credibility ordering across postures: open submissions above mixed labelled above customer-story above company-supplied
expectations.evidence: No ordering of open > mixed > customer-story > company-supplied is given.

expectations.text: Notes that open submissions also tops the effort ordering, citing the review cycle and the cost of refusing internal speakers
expectations.evidence: Mentions only 'extra administration' and review capacity, with no effort ordering.

expectations.text: Does not justify a posture on cheapest-first or message-control-per-effort grounds
expectations.evidence: Justified on the Q7/Q8 conditions and credibility.

expectations.text: Sets the measurement gate as counting company slots on the final program against the planned number, watching for drift
expectations.evidence: 'count company slots on the final program against the number fixed before the call opened.'

expectations.text: Routes what the chosen posture entitles the event to claim about itself to the positioning decision rather than declaring the event neutral or community-run
expectations.evidence: 'event-positioning decides what the event may say about itself.'

expectations.text: Routes session formats and track structure to the format-selection sibling rather than designing the agenda
expectations.evidence: 'event-format-selection: track count, session mix...'
